method: Every original image was inspected individually at readable full-image display size. Replacement images were also inspected and checked against exact public source records. Qualitative comparison of organizing relationships and distractions; no measured model-recognition benchmark.

assets.visual_reason: The twilight photo underexposes the base and solid end wall, while top-edge foliage and reflected canopy compete with the facade. A closer brighter workshop-corner view makes the glazing/volume relationship more legible.
assets.current_view_basis: Two large multi-storey glazed workshop planes meet at an exposed corner and are divided by a fine repeated metal grid. White horizontal base and roof bands frame the transparent gridded volume without applied historical decoration. At the left a lower horizontally glazed bridge volume joins the taller workshop block; its opening and connecting relationship remain legible. The facade and internal floor-edge bands are readable across the main image, with no tree branches or foreground objects crossing the central corner.

assets.visual_reason: Three chairs, window grids and equally strong doubled shadows compete with the open frame. An isolated museum object separates tube outline, contact bands and voids immediately.
assets.current_view_basis: A single complete chair is isolated against a pale neutral background, without other chairs, windows, display labels or strong projected shadows. Bent reflective tubular members trace the open perimeter and continuous floor-level support relationships. Separate dark seat, back and arm bands bridge the metal members instead of enclosing the frame in a padded solid mass. Thin contact bands, repeating rails and large intervening gaps separate the sitter’s surfaces from the support outline.

assets.visual_reason: The complete painting fills the frame. Unequal orthogonal fields share boundaries and form nonmirror counterbalance; no label, person or setting competes with them.
assets.current_view_basis: The complete painting fills the frame. Unequal orthogonal fields share boundaries and form nonmirror counterbalance; no label, person or setting competes with them.

assets.visual_reason: The whole poster shows the constructed title and smaller right-hand information system clearly. A narrow horizontal discolored band is visible but does not hide words or the asymmetric hierarchy. Its serif information type is a legitimate variation, not grounds to reject it as non-Swiss.

assets.visual_reason: A large foreground pine crosses the glass enclosure, the building occupies only part of the image and visitors/outdoor sculpture compete with the reduced volumes. The empty passage view makes planar wall, repeated frames and active void clearer.
assets.current_view_basis: A continuous plain concrete wall runs beside a transparent outer wall and glazed roof, leaving a long empty passage between them. Repeated slender vertical and overhead members establish a regular progression toward a small far opening. Strong linear frame shadows fall across the uncluttered floor and glass, making intervals and perspective depth easy to inspect. The main view contains no visitors, display sculptures, furniture groupings or foreground tree branches; attention rests on wall, frame, gap and light relationships.

assets.visual_reason: The entire Judd stack is isolated on a plain wall with no visitors or labels. Repeated projecting boxes and equal intervening voids are directly visible; their arrangement is the subject rather than incidental sparse decor.

assets.visual_reason: The 542px monochrome archival photo is too small and gray for an immediate textile comparison; it suppresses field/border color distinctions and fine pattern contrast. The different documented CMA court robe supplies a complete full-color garment view with clear registers.
assets.current_view_basis: The complete laid-flat garment is isolated against a neutral pale background, with both extended sleeves, cuffs and hem visible in color. Dense dragons and cloud-like scrolls occupy the central body and shoulders, while long gold-colored outer sleeve fields are relatively plain. A dark patterned border follows the collar and asymmetrical front closure, separating that edge from the main motif field. Dark decorated cuffs form distinct sleeve-end zones; cresting wave-like bands and a wide multicolored diagonal-striped hem create separate lower registers.

assets.visual_reason: The isolated whole vase has no setting clutter, readable openwork belly and sharply separated dark-blue/gold neck/shoulder/foot zones. Ornament itself creates the hierarchy; it is not extraneous scene noise.

assets.visual_reason: Tourists, saturated seasonal foliage and carefully regular raked sand compete with the pavilion. The image mainly signals a Japanese tourist site and garden maintenance, not the restrained individual material/time relationships needed here.
The full isolated bowl has a gently irregular rim/body profile, uneven dark surface and local sheen, with no competitive props. Its restrained format makes small material differences inspectable.

assets.visual_reason: Strong yellow cast/saturation and numerous bright chandelier points compete with the glazed skeleton and encourage gold-luxury/Baroque readings. A better same-monument view makes ribs, slender verticals and tall glazing clearer.
assets.current_view_basis: Pointed vault ribs repeat from bay to bay and continue toward slender vertical members beside tall stained-glass fields. Glazing occupies most upper wall fields, while narrow structural-looking strips articulate the vertical rhythm. A large circular rose with branching curved tracery organizes the far wall above a narrower horizontal gallery/entrance zone. The roof stars and gold accents remain subordinate to the legible rib, bay and window hierarchy; no visitors or temporary display elements obstruct this upward view.

assets.visual_reason: Several foreground diners, menus, mismatched cafe furniture, strong lamps and large venue lettering compete with the industrial shell. The main view is visually busy despite correct reuse identity.
assets.current_view_basis: A high exposed roof of repeated trusses, beams and suspended service/lighting tracks spans the open interior. Large gridded glazing and repeated tall dark vertical members set the hall scale and organize several levels. New stairs, glass-edged landings, book rows and restrained reading furniture sit within the larger frame rather than covering it with a closed ceiling. Riveted/paint-varied older-looking frame elements coexist with darker new-looking insertions; two small people at the lower edge do not obscure the roof, bays or stairs.

assets.visual_reason: Restaurant umbrellas, retail signs, a prominent flag and tourists compete with the stepped white building group. The view risks teaching a holiday-tourism collage instead of regional massing and transitions.
assets.current_view_basis: Numerous mostly white and some pastel building volumes adjoin and step across the cliff slope rather than form isolated objects on a flat site. Flat roof terraces, rounded roof/parapet segments, small dark openings and exterior transitions recur across the cluster. A long exterior stair/path descends alongside the settlement and connects several levels; the sea and landform provide readable setting. Architecture dominates the view without a foreground restaurant, large flag or retail sign. A small pack-animal/rider group remains near the lower edge and does not obscure the building combinations.

assets.visual_reason: An actual inhabited-looking room shows varied furniture silhouettes, layered patterned textiles, asymmetrical wall objects and plants at readable size. The large chandelier is part of its designed layered composition, not a foreign obstruction. This is a Jungalow/boho interior branch, with maximalist overlap.
